notes: Digital snake / stage box for the X32 ecosystem (16 Midas-designed remote mic preamps in, 8 balanced XLR out, AES50 networking). Physical I/O and specs cross-verified against the official Behringer/Klark Teknik "DIGITAL SNAKE S16 User Manual" (Section 7, Specifications table) and the official Behringer product brochure — both agree with the behringer.com product page. Notes/caveats: (1) AES50 A/B and Ultranet ports are standard RJ45 (8P8C) jacks per Klark Teknik SuperMAC/AES50; manual recommends shielded Cat-5e cable with EtherCon-terminated ends for road use, but the panel jacks themselves are plain RJ45, not locking EtherCon jacks. (2) AES50 and Ultranet carry proprietary digital-audio protocols, not generic Ethernet, so no eth-* speed grade is stated or applied. (3) The two ADAT Toslink outputs are labeled together as "ADAT OUT" on the rear panel (carrying channels 1-8/9-16 or AES50 ch17-24/25-32 depending on mode); labeled "ADAT Out 1"/"ADAT Out 2" here for disambiguation since the manual doesn't give each an individual name. (4) USB Type-B port is for firmware updates only via PC; manual does not state a USB spec version (device predates USB 3.x; likely USB 1.1/2.0 full-speed), so grade omitted. (5) Power inlet is a standard IEC C13/C14 socket (confirmed via brochure rear-panel callout "Standard IEC Power socket"), switch-mode autoranging 100-240V 50/60Hz, 45W consumption. (6) Phones output is a single 1/4" (6.35mm) mono TRS jack.
